title: Placeholder fixture: Hollow of the Grey Mother
note: PLACEHOLDER. Not game design. This pack exists to prove the schema can express the game's rules, to give the tests something to break, and to be the first input for the step 2 engine. Every class, number, name and enemy here is disposable; real content comes from steps 13 to 16. Rewritten for schema 0.4 (step 4's combat), keeping step 1's ids.

design.note: Placeholder targets taken from the concept spec, which was bullish on them. Expect every number here to change.

stats.name: MP regen
stats.note: MP restored every 5 ticks, through the status it brings.

stats.name: Aggro
stats.note: Default targeting picks foes weighted by it. Warriors start at 20.

stats.name: Thorns
stats.note: Damage dealt back to whoever lands a hit, through the status it brings.

statuses.name: BLEED
statuses.label: debuff
statuses.note: No element, so Armor and Resistance never touch it.

statuses.name: ROT
statuses.label: debuff
statuses.note: Typeless: Attack and Magic never scale status damage.

statuses.name: BARRIER
statuses.label: buff
statuses.note: A shield: an Intensity status with an absorb, capped at half the holder's max HP.

statuses.name: FOCUSED
statuses.text: Harder to hit, and hits more surely.
statuses.label: buff

statuses.name: RABID
statuses.text: Attacks faster for each fallen packmate.
statuses.label: buff

verbs.name: Physical damage
verbs.note: Deals physical damage, or raises attack.

verbs.name: Magic damage
verbs.note: Deals magic damage, or raises magic.

verbs.name: Damage over time
verbs.note: Applies a status that deals damage on turn_start or turn_end.

verbs.name: Burst
verbs.note: Raises crit chance, crit damage or damage dealt, or multiplies an action's amount above 1.

verbs.name: Multi-hit
verbs.note: An action that hits more than once per use.

verbs.name: Area
verbs.note: Splashes onto the target's allies, or hits every enemy at once.

verbs.name: Initiative
verbs.note: Acts earlier: the acts_first flag, or more speed.

verbs.name: Counter
verbs.note: Acts back at, or damages, whoever caused an event.

verbs.name: Control
verbs.note: Applies a status that costs the target its turn.

verbs.name: Evasion
verbs.note: High base evasion, or raises evasion.

verbs.name: Blocking
verbs.note: High base block chance, or raises it.

verbs.name: Armour
verbs.note: High base defence, raises defence, or lowers damage taken.

verbs.name: Protect
verbs.note: Draws enemy attacks away from allies: raises aggro, or has high base aggro.

verbs.name: Numbers
verbs.note: Gets stronger depending on how many allies are alive.

verbs.name: Cleanse
verbs.note: Removes statuses from a target or an ally.

classes.name: Warrior
classes.text: Front-line fighters who hold the line.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.text: Keepers of the old rites, who keep everyone standing.

specializations.name: Warrior: Vanguard
specializations.text: Holds the front, cleaves through crowds, and steps in when friends falter.

specializations.name: Ranger: Archer
specializations.text: Shoots fast, bleeds what it hits, and covers friends in trouble.

specializations.name: Ranger: Duelist
specializations.text: Fights up close, slips every blow, and saves it all for one decisive lunge.

specializations.name: Cleric: Mender
specializations.text: Mends wounds, lifts curses, and smites when nobody needs her.

abilities.name: Cleave
abilities.text: Hits every enemy for a little over half damage.

abilities.name: Stand Guard
abilities.text: When an ally drops below half health, taunts and braces.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.text: Bashes an enemy with the shield. It may be stunned.
abilities.note: Scales with Armor: only Attack and Magic are type-locked.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.text: When badly hurt, recovers a fifth of its health.

abilities.name: Barbed Arrows
abilities.text: A barbed shot that leaves the target bleeding.

abilities.name: Volley
abilities.text: Looses arrows at up to three enemies.

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.text: Two fast shots, with no wind-up.

abilities.name: Covering Fire
abilities.text: When an ally falls below half health, shoots to slow an enemy down.

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.text: For a while, strikes back after every dodge.

abilities.name: Read the Blade
abilities.text: Watches closely: harder to hit, and hits more surely.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.text: Lunges at the most wounded enemy for one big hit.

abilities.name: Mend
abilities.text: Heals the most wounded ally below 60% health.

abilities.name: Purify
abilities.text: Lifts the newest affliction from an ally.

abilities.name: Blessed Ward
abilities.text: Wraps the most wounded ally in a ward that soaks up damage.

abilities.name: Radiance
abilities.text: Burns every enemy with holy light.

abilities.name: Howl
abilities.note: Once per fight, in effect: every action starts the fight on cooldown, so a long cooldown would mean never. The condition reads the status it gives instead.

abilities.name: Maul
abilities.text: Rears up and mauls a foe.

gear.name: Rusted Sword
gear.text: It's seen better days. So have you.

gear.name: Notched Blade
gear.text: Every notch is a story. Most of them end badly for someone else.

gear.name: Ash Staff
gear.text: Cut from the old tree's lowest branch, with permission.

gear.name: Studded Jerkin
gear.text: Leather, studs, and a faint smell of wolf.

gear.name: Wolfhide Cloak
gear.text: Light enough to move in. Easier still when you're running for your life.

gear.name: Bone Charm
gear.text: Carved from something that used to bite.

gear.name: Ullr's Yew
gear.text: A bow from the hunting god's own tree. It looses two arrows at once.

gear.name: Yata Mirror
gear.text: A sacred mirror. Whoever strikes its bearer is struck back.

gear.name: Gjallarhorn
gear.text: The horn that will one day call the end of the world. For now, it calls the charge: the whole party starts each fight hasted.

formations.name: Open Order
formations.text: Everyone finds a spot. No tricks.

formations.name: Hearth Guard
formations.text: One shield out front draws every blow, so the hunters behind it can work.

formations.name: Phalanx
formations.text: Three shields locked at the front, two strikers safe behind.

positions.name: Left Striker
positions.text: Hard to target. More critical hits.

positions.name: Right Striker
positions.text: Hard to target. More critical hits.

formations.name: Hunting Party
formations.text: A headsman for the big blow, flankers who find the gaps, and a sanctuary for whoever needs it.

positions.name: Headsman
positions.text: Much slower. Hits half again as hard.

positions.name: Sanctuary
positions.text: Heals land a quarter stronger here.

formations.name: Flash Flood
formations.text: Everyone charges at once: the whole party moves faster, but nobody watches their flank.

enemies.name: Ash Wolf
enemies.text: A lean grey wolf. Agile, and strong in numbers: it turns rabid when a packmate falls.

enemies.name: Bog Wight
enemies.text: A drowned thing that hangs back in the reeds, festering everything it touches.

enemies.name: Grey Mother
enemies.text: Thick-hided and grey with age, she strikes many times, shrugs off any stun, and turns savage when badly hurt.

keyholes.note: Armor 7 eats small hits: flurries and double shots do little. Magic, bleeds and big hits get through.
Two hits every 10 ticks, sometimes bleeding: armor and healing blunt it.

enemies.note: Immune to lockouts covering all actions (no stun), but a silence would still land.

perks.name: Keen Eyes
perks.text: Your whole party lands critical hits more often.

perks.name: Swift Feet
perks.text: Your party attacks a little quicker.

perks.name: Battle Rhythm
perks.text: Your party attacks much quicker, and recovers abilities faster.

perks.name: Wolf's Blood
perks.text: Your party is a little hardier.

perks.name: Red Riposte
perks.text: The Duelist leaves a bleeding wound on anyone it dodges.

perks.name: Serrated Heads
perks.text: Rangers' basic attacks have a 50% chance to cause bleeding.

perks.name: Haemorrhage
perks.text: Every bleed your party causes runs much deeper.

perks.name: Braced Shields
perks.text: Warriors' armor is a quarter stronger.

perks.name: Second Breath
perks.text: Every unit recovers MP a little faster.

perks.name: Stand Fast
perks.text: Your party shrugs off blows, and magic too.

dungeons.name: Hollow of the Grey Mother
dungeons.text: A wolf den under the roots of an old ash. Something big sleeps at the bottom.

challenges.text: Beat it with only two units.
